children: SPCX Q3 revenue $14.58B (+161% YoY), adj EPS $0.35. Segment revenues: Super Intelligence $7.6B, Connectivity/Starlink $5.2B, Space $1.8B. 12 customer launches; Starlink 13.6M subs; net income $4.4B.
Up to 1.3 billion SPCX shares unlock Oct 22 (~28% of main lockup); another 328 million unlock Oct 24. Exact dates and share counts disclosed; no further holder or use details.
SpaceX (SPCX) agreed to supply Google 110,000 Nvidia GPUs and related gear, with a $920 million monthly payment obligation from Oct 2026 through Jun 2029; termination options after Dec 31.
SPCX formed independent board committees to evaluate a potential merger with Tesla; Elon Musk said he won't join the committees due to roles at both companies.
Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) posted quarterly capex of $19.6B, with $16.4B for its AI unit. Management says heavy investment will continue to expand computing infrastructure.
SPCX CEO Elon Musk forecast $500B–$1T ARR by end-2027, Starship weekly flights by H1 2027 with higher cadence later, Flight Test 15 next month, ongoing Starlink launches and compute expansion.
SpaceX reported a $63 billion backlog as of Sept. 30 and management reiterated a $100 billion annual recurring revenue target, per the CFO; no further financial details or timeline provided.
SpaceX's Starlink has contracts covering about 12,000 aircraft—roughly 25% of commercial planes. Production has quadrupled, and deals exist with three of the four major U.S. carriers.
Bank of America analysts say Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) traders will focus on Starship and Super Heavy progress, heat shield and recovery updates, and Starlink V3 satellite performance.
Elon Musk said a merger of Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) with Tesla is possible but not certain; any deal would need approval from holders of 50% of Tesla shares.
